title: Initialize @thdk/nx-claude in a workspace
description: Runs on `nx add @thdk/nx-claude`. Optionally installs the bundled nx-claude usage skill into the workspace.

skill.description: Install the bundled nx-claude usage skill (teaches the generators + conventions) into the workspace.
skill.x-prompt: Install the nx-claude usage skill into .claude/skills?

skillDir.description: Directory to install the skill into. The skill lands in <skillDir>/nx-claude/SKILL.md.

link.description: Symlink the shipped skill from node_modules instead of copying it. Version-matches automatically but is not portable (Windows/Docker/fresh clones before install) — copy is recommended.
